svg.aria-label: One narrated event with two participants discovers three facts by different routes; a referenced event hangs off it; perception edges from characters to facts, and one perception shown over story time closing and reopening as a new edge
svg.text: HOW A STORY IS WRITTEN AND READ · THE FULL BI-TEMPORAL MODEL
An illustration with names from Hound, not rows from the graph: one narrated event yields facts by different routes; a perception is closed and a new one opened.
A light shows from the Hall
ONE PERCEPTION OVER STORY TIME · A CHANGE IS A NEW EDGE, NEVER AN EDIT
Spoilers off: the slider's text offset picks which edge is visible. Spoilers on: the story clock does, and the referenced event (dashed) appears
when its own earlier time passes.
story_until set · retracted_pos = the new edge's reveal
cause_event: the watch · open: story_until null
revealed_pos of both edges: the same page
